استكثرت (form X)

# اِسْتَكْثَرْتَ (istakṯarta) /is.tak.θar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اِسْتَكْثَرْتِ (istakṯarti) /is.tak.θar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَكْثَرَ (istakṯara)
# اِسْتَكْثَرَتْ (istakṯarat) /is.t
